title: Extraction Method C
author: SARAH SIU TZE MAK
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iaecabe
materials: Replace the buffer with fresh buffer.

steps.title: Pre‑digest samples
steps.instruction: Incubate all samples at 56 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Second overnight digestion
steps.instruction: Add fresh proteinase‑K‑containing buffer and incubate for 12 hours.

steps.title: Centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Spin the digested samples at 6000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Mix supernatant with PB buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 500 µL of the supernatant with modified PB buffer at a 1:8 ratio (i.e., add 4000 µL buffer).

steps.title: Purify DNA with Monarch columns
steps.instruction: Load the mixture onto Monarch DNA Cleanup Columns (New England Biolabs) and centrifuge as per the column protocol.

steps.title: Wash column with buffer PE
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of Buffer PE (Qiagen) to the column and centrifuge according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Elute DNA with buffer EB
steps.instruction: Perform two elution washes with 17 µL Buffer EB (Qiagen), each followed by a 5‑minute incubation at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 17 µL Buffer EB (first wash) to the column.

steps.title: Analyze extracts on TapeStation
steps.instruction: Take a small aliquot of each extract and run it on an Agilent 2200 TapeStation HS chip to estimate fragment size distribution and molar concentration.
